evals.prompt: Write a Seedance lighting phrase and a full Seedance 2.5 prompt for an interrogation scene. A detective questions a suspect in a windowless room under soft cross lighting that splits the detective's face into a lit half and a shadowed half.
evals.expected_output: A Seedance 2.5 prompt whose Visual Style slot carries a soft cross lighting phrase naming direction and quality, with the split face expressed as observable shadow behavior.
expectations: The output places the lighting phrase in the Visual Style slot using 'The visuals feature ... lighting'.
The output names a 90-degree soft cross direction.
The output names the light quality (soft or diffused).
The output describes the split face as observable shadow behavior (one half lit, one half in shadow).
The output names exactly one dominant lighting direction.

evals.prompt: Write a Seedream prompt for a character element sheet of a woman at sunset using contre-jour backlight. She should have a warm halo rim and a readable face.
evals.expected_output: A Seedream image prompt with the lighting intent expressed in the Lighting: section as a contre-jour backlight recipe.
expectations: The output uses the Lighting: section for the lighting direction.
The output names contre-jour backlight behind the subject.
The output names a warm color temperature or amber/golden tone.
The output states the face remains readable despite the backlight.
The output does not put lighting wording in the Subject or Style sections.

evals.prompt: Write both a Seedream Lighting: recipe and a Seedance visual-style phrase for a candlelit dinner scene lit only by the candles and lamps visible in frame. No hidden fill light is allowed.
evals.expected_output: A practicals-only lighting treatment for both models that restricts light sources to those visible in frame and adds no off-camera fill.
expectations: The output restricts the light sources to the practicals visible in frame (candles and lamps).
The output states no hidden fill or off-camera source is used.
The Seedream recipe appears under the Lighting: section.
The Seedance phrase appears in the Visual Style slot.
The output names a warm color temperature consistent with candlelight.

evals.prompt: Write a Seedream prompt for a studio portrait of an older man with Rembrandt lighting. Include the triangle of light on the shadowed cheek.
evals.expected_output: A Seedream portrait prompt whose Lighting: section describes a Rembrandt key with the triangle-of-light cue on the shadowed cheek.
expectations: The output uses the Lighting: section for the lighting recipe.
The output names a 45-degree upper key direction.
The output includes the triangle of light on the shadowed cheek as an observable cue.
The output names the light quality (soft).
The output keeps one dominant lighting direction.

evals.prompt: I want a lighting direction and quality for a rooftop scene. It is a night scene with neon signage, but the brief also mentions golden hour. Choose one coherent lighting direction and quality and write the Seedance visual-style phrase.
evals.expected_output: A single coherent lighting choice (night neon, not golden hour) with direction, quality, and gel color, expressed as one Seedance visual-style phrase.
expectations: The output picks exactly one dominant lighting direction and quality.
The output does not mix golden hour and night neon in the same phrase.
The output names a night-neon direction with a neon gel or cool color temperature.
The output names the light quality (soft or hard).
The output sits in the Visual Style slot using 'The visuals feature ... lighting'.

evals.prompt: Write a Seedream Lighting: recipe for a cyberpunk street portrait. Hard key from the right tinted neon blue (#0099FF), with a bright cool ambient fill.
evals.expected_output: A Seedream Lighting: recipe composed from the relight-style direction (hard side key) plus a gel color, using the direction + quality + color_temp_or_gel + ratio template.
expectations: The output uses the Lighting: section for the recipe.
The output names a hard key direction from one side (right).
The output includes the gel color as neon blue or the hex #0099FF tinting the key.
The output names the quality (hard).
The output composes a single coherent recipe with one dominant source.
